TCP::lossfilter
Description
This iRule command sets the burst and rate levels in which TCP ignores
loss.
Burst range is valid from 0 to 32. Higher values decrease the chance
of performing congestion control
Rate range is valid from 0 to 1,000,000. Rate is X packets lost per
million before congestion control kicks in.
Syntax
TCP
::
lossfilter
<
rate
>
<
burst
>
